responsibility: Implements RTL CFG cleanup and simplification passes centered on `cleanup_cfg`. It removes unreachable blocks, forwards edges through forwarder blocks, simplifies conditional-jump-around-jump patterns, merges compatible basic blocks, performs jump threading and cross-jumping/tail merging when enabled, coordinates dead-insn and dead-jumptable cleanup around those structural changes, and provides the RTL pass hooks (`jump`, `jump_after_combine`, `jump2`) that run these control-flow simplifications at different pipeline points.
same_name_distinction: Implements the RTL CFG simplification engine and jump-related RTL passes, performing unreachable-block deletion, edge forwarding, block merging, threading, and cross-jumping; unlike gcc/cfgcleanup.h, it contains the optimization algorithms and pass bodies rather than their public declarations.
